paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: ChatGPT subscription prices by country (Go/Plus/Pro), refreshed daily from
each App Store, with USD and CNY conversion.
# dsh-chatgpt-price

> ChatGPT 各国订阅价格看板 — a DeepSeek Harness plugin that
> keeps a **daily-refreshed** table of what Chat

GPT costs in each country's App Store
> (Go / Plus / Pro 100 / Pro 200 / Pro 500), converted to CNY

at the **live USD/CNY rate
> fetched on every refresh**, with a day-over-day change mark, plan selec
tion and per-plan sorting.
## What it does
| **Source** | Apple's `viewSoftware` product endpoint, pinned to a storefront by header — public, f

ast, tax-inclusive in-app prices |
| **Plans** | Go · Plus · Pro 100 · Pro 200 · Pro 500 (consumable

s such as `N Credits` are dropped) |
| **Regions** | 33 storefronts by default, including PH / PK /

VN / ID / EG / AR / CO / CL / NG / UA; HK / CN report "not sold there" instead of a fake price |
| *
*Conversion** | local → USD (per-currency rate) → CNY at the **live USD/CNY rate of that same refres

h** |
| **Refresh** | once a day at `refreshHour` in `timeZone`, plus a boot refresh when the cache

is older than 20 h |
| **UI** | a Settings page, plus an optional `dsh-better-sidebar` tab |
| **Age
nt tools** | `chatgpt_price_board`, `refresh_chatgpt_prices` |
### 界面用法

- 顶部档位按钮（Go / Plus / Pro 100 / Pro 200 / Pro 500）就是「当前档位」选择器：
摘要行的最低/最高/价差、**相对美国**列以及所有排序都按选中档位计算；再

点一次已选
档位即回到「全部档位」，列出所有列。
- 「排序」下拉：默认顺序 / 价格从低到高 / 价格从高到低 / 相对美国从低到高。没取到
价格的地区始终排在最后，选择会被记住。
- 当前档位里最
便宜的一格标「最便宜」，行首 `#` 是当前排序下的名次。
## Why the App Store and not chatgpt.com

`chatgpt.com/pricing` renders its price numbers client-side: the server HTML contains
plan cards wit

h an empty price span, and the page is byte-identical for every
`?country=`. `/backend-api/payments/

checkout/prices` answers 404. The App Store product
page, in contrast, is public, fast and embeds ev

ery in-app purchase as a
`leadingText` / `trailingText` pair ("ChatGPT Plus" → "¥3,000"). Two caveat

s the parser
handles:

- consumable rows (`100 Credits` …) are not plans and are dropped;
- the list contains a **duplicate

** `ChatGPT Plus` row carrying the Pro-200 price, so
duplicates are resolved to the **lowest** amoun

`ChatGPT Plus` row carrying the Pro-200 price, so
duplicates are resolved to the **lowest** amount.
### Why the fetch does not use `apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/…`

From a mainland-China egress that URL now answers `302 → /cn`, and the CN storefront
does not sell t

his app, so the request lands on Apple's "Today" page with no product
data — every region failing wi

th "no prices on the page". `itunes.apple.com/WebObjects/
MZStore.woa/wa/viewSoftware` is not geo-re

directed and honours
`x-apple-store-front: <id>-<n>,29`, which pins the storefront regardless of the

onours
`x-apple-store-front: <id>-<n>,29`, which pins the storefront regardless of the
visitor's IP.

The trap: a **wrong `<n>` does not fail** — Apple silently answers as the US store, HTTP
200 and all

. So every response is validated against the storefront the page reports for
itself (`storefront.cc`

) and rejected on mismatch, trying the next candidate header.
Measured 2026-10-30: suffix `1` for US

/JP, `5` for CA, `2` for the other 30. A header
that answered correctly is remembered, so a warm boa

rd makes exactly one request per
region. Amounts come from `buyParams`' `price` field — an integer i

n thousandths of the
currency unit, exact where the display string is localised text.

Hong Kong and mainland China storefronts return 404 (the app is not sold there); those
regions are r
eported as unavailable instead of being silently missing.
## Install
The bundle is a normal file package; install the directory, not a tarball:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

or from the Harness UI: **Settings → Plugins → install bundle**, choosing this folder.
The bundle pa
tch inserts one host row (`id: chatgpt-price`). Restart the app to mount it.
## Config

Override the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the whole
`config`, so restat
e every key you keep):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| key | default | meaning |

| `regions` | 33 storefronts | App Store storefront codes to track |
| `timeZone` / `refreshHour` |

`Asia/Shanghai` / `9` | when the daily refresh happens |
| `rateSources` | open.er-api → exchangerat

e-api → frankfurter | FX providers, tried in order on **every** refresh |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `20

000` | per-request timeout |
| `concurrency` / `requestsPerSecond` | `4` / `6` | politeness limits |

| `retries` | `2` | per-region retries after a failed page (404 is never retried) |
| `retryDelayMs

` | `800` | retry backoff base; attempt N waits N × this |
| `retryMinutes` | `5` | re-run the whole

refresh this long after a failed/partial run (`0` disables) |
| `autoRefreshOnBoot` | `true` | refr

esh at startup when the snapshot is older than 20 h |
| `maxHistoryDays` | `90` | days of history ke
pt in the snapshot |
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **Host half** does one scrape per day for every tracked region, refetches the live FX
table on the

same run, writes an atomic JSON file, and exposes two routes and two agent
tools. Every open window

reads the cache, so ten windows cost zero extra requests.
- **Browser half** only *reads* the cache

d snapshot from the host and renders it with
theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), so light and dark follo

rom the host and renders it with
theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), so light and dark follow the shell.
## Routes and tools
| kind | name | purpose |

| `GET` | `/plugins/dsh-chatgpt-price/snapshot` | the cached snapshot (loopback only) |
| `POST` | `

/plugins/dsh-chatgpt-price/refresh` | force a refresh, returns the new snapshot (loopback only) |
|

tool | `chatgpt_price_board` | read rows, filter by region / plan |
| tool | `refresh_chatgpt_prices
` | force a refresh and summarise the result |
The snapshot file is `chatgpt-price.json` in the DSH data directory.
